title: gomphostemma javanicum
intro: Gomphostemma javanicum, commonly known as the Java gomphostemma, is a type of plant that belongs to the family Lamiaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The health benefits of Gomphostemma javanicum include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions in reducing inflammation, fighting infections, and protecting against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
